tabs.Характеристики: A low-pH gel for daily face cleansing. It helps wash away everyday impurities and excess sebum, leaving skin feeling clean and fresh. The formula contains gentle cleansing agents and betaine salicylate. Use it morning and evening; if your skin is sensitive, start with occasional use and watch how it reacts.
tabs.Состав: Contains gentle cleansing agents, betaine salicylate and tea tree oil. The brand also lists hydrating ingredients and plant extracts, including yeast ferment extract.
tabs.Применение: Wet your face and hands. Squeeze a small amount of gel into your palms, add water and work into a lather. Gently massage over skin, avoiding the eye area, then rinse thoroughly. Use in the morning and/or evening. If your skin is sensitive or new to exfoliating ingredients, start with a few times a week.

tabs.Характеристики: A balm for the first cleansing step. It helps dissolve makeup, including long-wear face and eye products, and removes sunscreen residue and other oil-based impurities. The texture melts as you massage it in and emulsifies when water is added. The brand describes Original as suitable for different skin types.
tabs.Состав: The formula also contains hot spring water, plant extracts, vitamin E and fragrance. Botanicals include bamboo, rooibos, angelica and acerola extracts.
tabs.Применение: With clean, dry hands, scoop a little balm with the spatula and apply to dry skin. Massage gently in circles to dissolve makeup and impurities. Add a little water and keep massaging until the balm turns into an emulsion. Rinse thoroughly with warm water. Follow with a foam or other second-step cleanser if needed.

tabs.Характеристики: A gentle daily gel cleanser that creates a soft foam and helps remove everyday impurities. The brand positions it as comfortable cleansing with a skin-friendly pH. It works well as a basic cleansing step but isn’t designed to dissolve long-wear makeup the way a cleansing oil or balm does.
tabs.Состав: Key ingredients are green plum water and mung bean seed extract. The formula also contains cleansing and hydrating agents. The brand describes it as non-aggressive cleansing.
tabs.Применение: Wet your face and hands, lather a small amount between your palms and spread over skin with light circular motions. Rinse with warm water and pat dry with a towel without rubbing. In the evening, if you wear heavy makeup, pre-cleanse first.

tabs.Характеристики: A first-step cleansing balm that helps dissolve makeup, sunscreen and sebum. It melts on dry skin and emulsifies and rinses off when water is added.
tabs.Состав: The formula combines cleansing oils and emulsifiers; the brand lists the enzyme protease and hydrating agents.
tabs.Применение: Apply the balm with dry hands to a dry face and massage gently, focusing on makeup and sunscreen. Add a little water until it turns milky, then rinse. Avoid harsh rubbing and contact with the eyes.

tabs.Характеристики: A foam that cleanses skin of everyday impurities and leftover skincare. It’s a rinse-off product and doesn’t replace an oil or balm first step when you wear long-wear makeup.
tabs.Состав: The DIVE-IN line features several forms of hyaluronic acid along with hydrating ingredients.
tabs.Применение: Wet your hands and face, lather a small amount and spread gently over skin. Rinse thoroughly and pat your face dry. If you feel dryness or tightness, use less product or cleanse less often, then follow with hydrating care.

tabs.Характеристики: A first-step cleansing oil. It helps dissolve makeup, sunscreen and sebum; mixed with water it turns into an emulsion and rinses away.
tabs.Состав: The formula has an oil base and emulsifiers plus heartleaf extract. The ingredient list includes plant oils and fragrance components.
tabs.Применение: Apply with dry hands to dry skin and massage to dissolve makeup and impurities. Wet your fingertips and keep massaging until the oil becomes a milky emulsion, then rinse thoroughly. Don’t apply to the eye mucosa; finish with a foam cleanser if needed.

somebymi-miracle-foam.description: Acid cleansing foam for blemish-prone skin

tabs.Характеристики: A rinse-off cleansing foam from the 30 Days Miracle line. It lathers up and helps remove impurities, and the formula includes ingredients the brand uses in care for breakout-prone skin.
tabs.Состав: Contains salicylic acid at 5,000 ppm (0.5%), tea tree water, centella extract and a small amount of a PHA ingredient.
tabs.Применение: Lather a small amount between wet palms, apply to your face with light movements and rinse thoroughly. Don’t use on broken skin and avoid the eye area. If you notice dryness, flaking or redness, use it less often or stop; during the day follow the brand’s sun-protection advice for AHA formulas.

purito-deep-sea-oil.description: Cleansing oil with olive and vitamin E

tabs.Характеристики: A cleansing oil for the first step of your evening routine. A blend of five plant oils gently dissolves makeup, sunscreen and excess sebum, and turns into a light milk on contact with water, rinsing off without a greasy film. Great for dry and normal skin that doesn’t like foam as a first step.
tabs.Состав: Based on olive oil with vitamin E, plus sunflower, jojoba, grapeseed and sweet almond oils. A short, no-frills formula: the oils soften skin and help remove long-wear makeup without rubbing.
tabs.Применение: Apply 2–3 pumps to a dry face with dry hands and massage in circles for 30–60 seconds. Add a little water so the oil turns milky, massage again and rinse with warm water. Then cleanse with a gentle foam.

tabs.Характеристики: A daily cleansing foam from the Mung Bean line. The brand positions it as a pH-balanced cleanser that removes everyday impurities and leaves skin clean without a heavy film.
tabs.Состав: The line’s star ingredient is mung bean extract; surfactants do the cleansing, and the formula is topped up with hydrating ingredients.
tabs.Применение: Wet your face and hands, lather a small amount and spread gently over skin. Rinse with plenty of water. If you feel persistent tightness or dryness after cleansing, use less product and cleanse less often.

tabs.Характеристики: Toner pads for quick care of skin prone to redness, oily shine and uneven texture. The soft side is for gentle wiping, the textured side for more thorough contact where you want to refresh the skin’s surface. You can also leave a pad on your face for a few minutes as a spot hydrating mask.
tabs.Состав: The formula combines heartleaf extract, niacinamide, panthenol and allantoin. The brand also lists a fermented hydrating complex, succinic acid and caffeine.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing, sweep a pad over your skin without pressing hard and avoiding the eye area. For spot care, place a pad on the area for a few minutes, then remove it and pat in the remaining essence. Adjust how often you use them to how your skin feels; stop if irritation appears.

tabs.Характеристики: A watery exfoliating toner for daily care of uneven texture and dull tone. It gently refreshes the skin’s surface after cleansing and preps it for the next steps. As an acid product, it doesn’t replace sunscreen and may not suit skin that tolerates exfoliants poorly.
tabs.Состав: Based on green plum water and mung bean extract, with AHA and BHA ingredients for gentle renewal. The formula also contains hydrating and softening agents.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing, apply a small amount with your palms or a cotton pad without rubbing. Start with occasional use and watch how your skin reacts, especially if your routine already includes acids or retinoids. Use sunscreen during the day; if you feel strong stinging, rinse it off and stop using it.

tabs.Характеристики: A refreshing toner for dull skin and uneven texture. The acid formula helps keep skin looking smoother, and the watery base is perfect after cleansing.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing, apply the toner to a cotton pad and gently sweep over your face, avoiding the eyes and lips; with sensitive skin, use your palms and start slowly. Don’t layer it with other strong acids or retinoids in the same routine unless your skin is used to that combination.

tabs.Характеристики: A light watery toner for skin that lacks moisture and comfort after cleansing. The formula targets multi-layer hydration and spreads quickly without a heavy creamy layer.
tabs.Состав: The brand highlights 14 forms of hyaluronic acid with different molecular weights and sea water from Ulleungdo Island. It also contains hydrating ingredients that help relieve the feeling of dryness.
tabs.Применение: Pat the toner onto clean skin of the face and neck with your palms, spread gently and let it absorb. If your skin needs more hydration, apply another thin layer, then seal it with a serum or cream. Avoid contact with the eyes.

tabs.Характеристики: Toner pads for dull tone and post-acne marks. The textile pad helps spread the essence quickly over your skin or use it locally on areas that need extra hydration and care. Sold in sets and with refills.
tabs.Состав: In the No.5 line the brand focuses on niacinamide, vitamin C, glutathione and tranexamic acid — ingredients for uneven tone — in a hydrating base.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing, gently sweep a pad over your face without pulling the skin. For spot care, leave the pad on the chosen area for a short time, then remove it and pat in the remaining essence. Avoid the eyes and use SPF in your daytime routine, especially if you also use acids or vitamin C.

tabs.Характеристики: A daily liquid toner for hydration and a smoother skin feel after cleansing. The Dokdo line is based on mineral sea water, and the texture is designed for light application without a heavy film. Use it as the first watery step of a basic routine.
tabs.Состав: Key ingredients are sea water from Ulleungdo Island, humectants, panthenol, allantoin and betaine. The brand also lists a ferment ingredient for skin-surface care.
tabs.Применение: Apply a small amount to clean skin with your palms or a cotton pad and spread gently. Let it absorb before serum and cream. If using a pad, don’t rub, and stop if persistent irritation appears.

tabs.Характеристики: Large soaked pads for refreshing, hydrating care of sensitive or tired skin. Use them for gentle wiping after cleansing or leave them on specific areas for a few minutes as a compress. A handy way to combine a toner and a spot-mask step.
tabs.Состав: The line’s key ingredients are carrot extract and carotene-rich carrot oil. The formula also includes a watery essence and humectants.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing, place pads on the areas you want to treat for a few minutes or gently sweep them over your face. Remove them, pat in the remaining essence, then follow with cream. Don’t use on broken skin and avoid the eye area.

tabs.Характеристики: A richer-feeling toner that softens skin and adds moisture after cleansing. The brand describes it as multi-purpose: layer it, apply with a cotton pad or use it as a short toner compress.
tabs.Состав: Highlights include ceramide NP, glycerin, panthenol, allantoin and sodium hyaluronate; the formula also contains plant extracts.
tabs.Применение: Pat the toner in with your palms after cleansing until absorbed. For richer care, apply several thin layers; alternatively, soak cotton pads and leave them on dry areas for about 10 minutes. Choose whichever method feels comfortable.

tabs.Характеристики: A light toner from the hydrating DIVE-IN line for skin that feels dry and tight. The watery texture spreads quickly and serves as the first layer of moisture after cleansing. Use it morning and evening, then follow with serum and cream.
tabs.Состав: The formula focuses on a complex of different hyaluronic acids, plus panthenol and allantoin. These ingredients help keep skin hydrated and comfortable.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing, pour a little toner into your palms, spread over your face and neck and let it absorb. Repeat with a thin layer if needed, without rubbing. Finish with cream; it doesn’t replace sunscreen in the morning.

tabs.Характеристики: A gel serum for dull tone, uneven texture and visible pores. If your skin is sensitive, introduce it gradually.
tabs.Состав: Key ingredients are propolis extract, niacinamide and betaine salicylate, plus humectants, sodium hyaluronate and plant extracts including centella. Keep the BHA ingredient in mind when combining it with other acid products.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing and toner, spread an appropriate amount of serum over your face. Let it absorb, then apply cream; in the morning finish with sunscreen. Patch-test before first use, especially if your skin is sensitive to bee products or acids.

torriden-dive-in-serum.description: Serum with five types of hyaluronic acid

tabs.Характеристики: A light serum for skin that lacks moisture or comfort. The watery texture spreads quickly and is designed as a daily hydrating layer that never feels heavy. Use it morning and evening before cream.
tabs.Состав: The key complex is five forms of hyaluronic acid with different molecular weights. The brand also highlights panthenol and allantoin for softening, soothing care.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing and toner, apply a few drops to your face and pat gently until absorbed. Then seal with cream. The brand also suggests applying it under DIVE-IN pads for a short time as an intensive hydrating compress.

tabs.Характеристики: A serum for hydrating care and a more radiant-looking complexion. In the PDRN Glow line the brand focuses on supporting firmness and smoothness; the airless pump helps dispense just the right amount. Designed for daily use morning and evening as directed by the brand.
tabs.Состав: Contains Sodium DNA (PDRN), niacinamide, panthenol, beta-glucan and sodium hyaluronate, complemented by hydrolyzed collagen and six peptide ingredients.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing and toner, pump and spread over your face and neck. Let the serum absorb, then apply moisturizer. Store away from extreme temperatures and direct sunlight, as the brand recommends.

tabs.Характеристики: A serum from the No.3 line for uneven texture and dull-looking skin. It aims to make the skin’s surface look smoother and adds a hydrating step to your daily routine.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing and toner, apply a small amount to your face, spread and pat gently until absorbed. Then use cream.

tabs.Характеристики: A soothing serum with Korean centella for sensitive, irritated and dehydrated skin. The light gel texture absorbs quickly, relieves tightness and helps skin look calmer and more even.
tabs.Состав: Centella asiatica extract and its four active compounds — madecassoside, asiaticoside, madecassic and asiatic acids — plus niacinamide, sodium hyaluronate, panthenol, allantoin, peptides and ceramide NP to hydrate and support the skin barrier.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing and toner, apply 2–3 drops to your face and neck and pat in lightly. Wait until the serum absorbs, then move on to cream. Suitable for morning and evening routines.

tabs.Характеристики: A light serum from the peach line for hydration and care of dull, uneven tone. The texture is watery, so it fits easily into a morning or evening routine.
tabs.Состав: Key ingredients are peach extract, 5% niacinamide, fermented ingredients, sodium hyaluronate and alpha-arbutin.
tabs.Применение: Apply a few drops to your face and neck after cleansing and toner, avoiding the eye area, then pat gently until absorbed. The brand allows use up to twice a day. In the morning, apply sunscreen after the serum.

tabs.Характеристики: A serum for redness and uneven texture. Introduce it gradually, especially if you use acids or retinoids.
tabs.Состав: Key ingredients are azelaic acid, a hyaluronic acid complex, panthenol and centella with its derivatives, providing active and hydrating care.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing and toner, apply a small amount to your face, avoiding the eye area. Start with occasional use and don’t combine it in one evening with several strong exfoliants unless your skin is used to them. Stop if persistent stinging or irritation occurs; wear SPF during the day.

tabs.Состав: The brand also lists arbutin, including alpha-arbutin, humectants and hyaluronic acid derivatives.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing and toner, apply a few drops to your face, spread gently and let it absorb, then use cream. If your skin is reactive, start with a small area and limited frequency. Use SPF in your daytime routine.

tabs.Характеристики: A hydrating serum with capsules in the texture to keep skin soft and looking plumper. Part of the PDRN Hyaluronic Acid Capsule 100 line.
tabs.Состав: The formula is built on salmon-DNA-derived PDRN and a hyaluronic acid complex, plus hydrating ingredients and collagen.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing and toner, apply the serum to your face and spread gently, then use cream. If you can see capsules in the texture, spread them evenly over your skin until absorbed.

tabs.Характеристики: A serum with a vitamin complex for dull skin tone and post-acne marks.
tabs.Состав: The formula contains 5% ascorbic acid, 2% sodium ascorbyl phosphate, 2% ethyl ascorbyl ether and 1.05% ascorbyl glucoside, plus glutathione, tocopherol and other antioxidants. It also contains alcohol and essential oils, including citrus and lavender — worth noting for sensitive skin.
tabs.Применение: Apply a small amount to clean skin and spread gently until absorbed. Start with a few times a week to see how your skin tolerates this rich vitamin formula. Always finish your morning routine with SPF; avoid contact with the eyes.

tabs.Характеристики: A nourishing ampoule for hydrating care and softer, more radiant-looking skin. The brand describes the texture as light for such a rich formula; apply after cleansing and toner.
tabs.Состав: The brand highlights red propolis and a complex of bee products, including honey and royal jelly.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing and toner, spread the ampoule over your face and pat gently until absorbed. The brand allows morning and evening use. During the day, finish with sunscreen.

tabs.Характеристики: A serum with a high concentration of pure vitamin C for dull tone, dark spots and early signs of photoaging. The formula is meant for people already familiar with vitamin C; sensitive skin should start especially slowly.
tabs.Состав: The main active is 23% pure ascorbic acid, complemented by vitamin E and glutathione; key ingredients also include niacinamide, panthenol and hyaluronic acid.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing and toner, apply 2–3 drops to your face, spread gently, then use cream. If using in the daytime, always apply SPF. The brand advises against combining it in the same routine with copper peptides and strong actives like retinol; separate them by time of day or by day.

tabs.Характеристики: A serum for uneven tone and visible post-acne marks. Apply the light formula all over or locally to areas with unwanted pigmentation.
tabs.Состав: The key active is 2% alpha-arbutin, combined with tranexamic acid, niacinamide and N-acetylglucosamine. Supporting ingredients include ferulic acid, glutathione, panthenol and several forms of hyaluronic acid.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing, apply the serum evenly and let it absorb. The brand allows layering two or three thin coats if needed. Use SPF in the morning, especially if your routine includes other tone-evening actives.

tabs.Характеристики: A hydrating essence that softens skin and keeps it comfortable. The texture is slightly stretchy but spreads in a thin layer; use it before cream.
tabs.Состав: Contains 96.3% snail secretion filtrate, betaine and sodium hyaluronate, plus allantoin and panthenol. Not vegan because of the snail-derived ingredient.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing and toner, apply a small amount to your face and pat gently until absorbed. Then use a moisturizer. Avoid it if you’re allergic to snail-derived ingredients.

tabs.Характеристики: An ampoule for hydrating, soothing care focused on uneven tone and post-acne marks.
tabs.Состав: The Onion Newpair line uses red onion extract. The ampoule also contains hydrating and soothing ingredients.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing and toner, apply an appropriate amount to your face, spread and pat gently until absorbed. Then apply cream. Start with your usual routine frequency and reduce it if you feel discomfort.

numbuzin-no5-glutathione.description: Glutathione serum for an even tone

tabs.Характеристики: A serum for dull tone and visible dark marks. The formula combines antioxidant and tone-evening ingredients; the brand also emphasizes hydration and barrier support.
tabs.Применение: Apply the serum after cleansing and toner, spread evenly and let it absorb. Then use cream; in the daytime, add sunscreen. If your skin is sensitive, patch-test first.

tabs.Характеристики: An ampoule for a hydrating, tone-evening layer. You can see capsules in the formula; it’s designed for dull-looking skin and uneven tone while keeping soothing centella at its core.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing and toner, apply the ampoule to your face, spreading the visible capsules evenly until absorbed. Then apply cream. In the daytime, finish with SPF; introduce gradually if your skin is sensitive.

tabs.Характеристики: A light watery ampoule for hydrating, soothing care. The brand positions it as a versatile product that helps skin look more comfortable and balanced. The texture spreads quickly and never feels heavy.
tabs.Применение: Drop an appropriate amount onto your face after cleansing and toner, or wherever it fits in your routine. Spread evenly and pat gently until absorbed, then apply cream.

tabs.Характеристики: A pure vitamin C serum for a more even, radiant-looking complexion. The brand describes it as a rich formula for dullness, dark spots and early signs of aging. Because of the high concentration, introduce it gradually, especially if your skin isn’t used to vitamin C.
tabs.Состав: The main active is 24% ascorbic acid. The formula also lists betaine, bisabolol and centella complex ingredients, plus peptides and collagen ingredients.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing and toner, apply 2–3 drops to your face and spread gently, then use cream. The brand recommends using it no more than once a day, preferably in the evening. If you apply it in the morning, finish with SPF; stop if you notice marked irritation.

manyo-bifida-ampoule.description: Bifida ampoule for the skin barrier

tabs.Характеристики: An ampoule for hydrating care that keeps skin looking comfortable. The line is based on fermented ingredients; apply a light layer after toner and before cream.
tabs.Применение: After toner, apply a generous amount along the contours of your face and pat gently with your fingertips until absorbed. Then finish with cream.

tabs.Характеристики: A capsule serum for dull tone and visibly uneven texture. The formula combines bright active ingredients with a softening base; if your skin is sensitive, introduce it carefully and don’t start several new actives at once.
tabs.Состав: The formula also includes allantoin, panthenol, squalane and glycolic acid, and contains cypress wood essential oil.
tabs.Применение: Apply a small amount to your face after toner, spread evenly and finish with cream. When starting out, use it less often and don’t combine it in one evening with strong acids or retinoids until you know how your skin tolerates it. Use SPF during the day.

tabs.Характеристики: A serum for post-acne marks, uneven tone and dullness. The light texture absorbs quickly, doesn’t weigh skin down and suits even oily skin. With regular use, skin looks more even and glows from within.
tabs.Состав: 5% niacinamide evens out tone and makes pores less visible. Rice bran, papaya and sea buckthorn extracts add radiance and antioxidant protection. Plant-derived squalane hydrates without greasiness, and allantoin soothes.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing and toner, apply a small amount all over or directly onto spots and spread until absorbed. Then apply cream, and always wear SPF during the day.
Apply a small amount after cleansing and toner, spread evenly and finish with cream. If using in the morning, apply SPF.

tabs.Характеристики: A retinal booster for skin firmness, fine lines and enlarged pores. Retinal works faster than classic retinol, while peptides and panthenol keep the care gentle. The small size is designed for an evening course.
tabs.Состав: 0.1% liposomal retinal penetrates deeper and irritates less. A 3% Matrixyl peptide complex supports firmness, and 1% panthenol soothes and hydrates. The formula also contains niacinamide.
tabs.Применение: Apply a small amount in the evening to clean, dry skin. For the first two weeks use it every other night, then nightly once your skin adjusts. If redness appears, use less, less often, and add a soothing cream. Always apply SPF in the morning.

tabs.Характеристики: A nourishing cream for dry, sensitive skin and a weakened barrier. The current version contains capsules with lipid ingredients for long-lasting hydration — the brand claims up to 120 hours. Available in several sizes.
tabs.Состав: Contains ceramide NP, cholesterol, phytosphingosine and fatty acids, plus niacinamide and allantoin. The brand describes the system as high-density ceramide capsules.
tabs.Применение: At the end of your routine, apply an appropriate amount to your face and spread gently until absorbed. Use morning and evening, adjusting the amount to how your skin feels. If the texture feels heavy, apply a thinner layer.

tabs.Характеристики: A rich cream for the final step of your routine when skin needs hydration and barrier support. Designed for morning and evening use; the soft creamy texture helps relieve dryness and makes skin look more elastic.
tabs.Состав: The brand lists 1.5% PDRN derived from salmon DNA, along with niacinamide, ceramide NP, panthenol, squalane, hyaluronic acid and several peptides.
tabs.Применение: Apply the cream after serum as the last step and spread evenly over your face. The brand allows morning and evening use. During the day, finish with sun protection.

tabs.Характеристики: A light moisturizing cream for skin that needs a calmer, more comfortable finish to the routine. The brand describes the texture as non-greasy and emphasizes support for the moisture barrier. Use it after serum or ampoule, morning and evening.
tabs.Состав: The formula features 70% heartleaf extract, panthenol and ceramide NP, plus cholesterol and hydrating ingredients.
tabs.Применение: After serum, apply the cream to your face and neck with your fingers or a clean spatula. Use morning and evening; in the morning, top with sunscreen. When skin feels dry, you can apply several thin layers if that’s comfortable.

tabs.Характеристики: A moisturizing cream from the PDRN Hyaluronic Acid Capsule 100 line. The brand promises long-lasting moisture retention and a comfortable texture for the final step of your routine.
tabs.Состав: Contains Sodium DNA (PDRN), hydrolyzed collagen, squalane, niacinamide and a complex of several forms of hyaluronic acid, plus centella and its derivatives.
tabs.Применение: Apply a small amount after serum, spread over your face and neck and gently tap in with your fingertips. Use as the last step morning or evening. Add SPF during the day.

tabs.Характеристики: A light cream for daily hydration and softer-looking skin. The brand describes the texture as non-sticky; it finishes your routine nicely and can be layered thinly in the cold season. According to the brand, the pink tint comes from vitamin B12, not an artificial dye.
tabs.Состав: Based on 77% peach fruit water, with niacinamide, panthenol, ceramide NP and fermented ingredients. The brand lists collagen and pectin as part of the hydrating complex. Contains fragrance — worth noting for sensitive skin.
tabs.Применение: After ampoule or serum, spread the cream over your face and neck and pat gently until absorbed. Use morning and evening. During the day, finish with sunscreen; when skin is dry, apply several thin layers.

tabs.Характеристики: A moisturizing cream for softer, more radiant-looking skin. Apply after toner and serum, morning and evening. For oily or breakout-prone skin, the brand recommends using less than for dry skin.
tabs.Состав: Key ingredients are rice bran water, ginseng root water, squalane and niacinamide, plus ceramide NP, honey and several forms of hyaluronic acid.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing, toner and serum, apply a small amount to your face and neck and pat gently until absorbed. Morning and evening, adjust the amount to how your skin feels. During the day, finish with SPF.

boj-red-bean-gel.description: Light gel cream for oily skin

tabs.Характеристики: A light gel cream that hydrates skin that doesn’t like heavy or greasy coverage. The brand positions it mainly for oily and breakout-prone skin; it keeps skin comfortable without a heavy layer. Use it morning and evening as the final hydrating step.
tabs.Состав: Key ingredients are red bean extract and a peptide complex. The formula also contains panthenol, allantoin, betaine and hydrating agents.
tabs.Применение: Apply a small amount to your face after serum and spread with light strokes. Suitable for day and night; if needed, layer a richer cream on dry areas. Apply SPF in the morning.

tabs.Характеристики: A night cream with retinal and bakuchiol for uneven texture and early signs of aging. Introduce it gradually, especially if your skin hasn’t used retinoids before. The brand recommends evening use.
tabs.Состав: The brand states 0.03% retinal and 1% bakuchiol, plus niacinamide, humectants and emollients including ceramide NP. According to the brand, the yellowish tint comes from retinal, not an artificial dye.
tabs.Применение: Apply in the evening after serum, starting with one or two times a week and a small amount. If your skin tolerates it well, gradually increase the frequency. Use SPF during the day; the brand advises against using it during pregnancy and breastfeeding and against combining it with vitamin C or exfoliants in the same routine.

tabs.Характеристики: A moisturizing face cream that helps relieve dryness and support the skin barrier. Ideal as the final step; the texture applies comfortably without a complicated multi-step routine.
tabs.Состав: The brand highlights ceramides, cholesterol, fatty acids, panthenol and several forms of hyaluronic acid. These help soften skin and lock in moisture.
tabs.Применение: Spread a small amount over your face after toner and serum. Use morning and/or evening; finish with sunscreen during the day.

tabs.Характеристики: A rich cream for daily care of skin that lacks hydration and firmness. Formulas in this line combine centella derivatives (TECA) with hydrating ingredients.

A light cream for daily care that the brand positions for skin prone to redness and blemishes. It hydrates and completes a basic routine; apply it locally or more widely, depending on what your skin needs.
tabs.Применение: Apply as the last step in a thin layer over your face or on areas that need extra hydration.

tabs.Характеристики: A cream for daily facial hydration, made for skin that lacks softness and comfort.
tabs.Применение: Apply an appropriate amount to your face after watery products and serum. Use morning and evening or as needed; top with SPF during the day.

tabs.Характеристики: A cream from the Water Bank line for hydration and skin barrier support. The brand promises a soft creamy texture and care for dry or dull skin.
tabs.Применение: Apply evenly to your face after cleansing, toner and serum, morning and/or evening. In your daytime routine, finish with sun protection.
