tabs.Применение: After cleansing and toner, spread a small amount over your face and neck and massage gently until absorbed. The brand suggests using it morning and evening; finish your morning routine with sunscreen. Introduce it gradually and watch how your skin reacts. Don’t apply to irritated or broken skin.

tabs.Характеристики: A retinal night cream for texture and the first visible signs of aging. The formula is topped up with softening and hydrating ingredients so that vitamin A care comes with comfort.
tabs.Состав: The key active is 0.1% retinal. The list also includes glycerin, squalane, safflower oil, shea butter, sodium hyaluronate, polyglutamic acid, ceramide NP and cholesterol for hydration and softness.
tabs.Применение: Use mainly in the evening on clean, dry skin: start with a small amount and occasional use, increasing frequency only if your skin tolerates it well. Don’t apply other retinoids or irritating actives to the same area at the same time. If skin gets dry, use it less often and add a simple moisturizer. Use sunscreen in the morning.

tabs.Состав: For the version on HERA’s international page, ingredients include Narcissus tazetta bulb extract, niacinamide, adenosine, squalane, shea butter and peptides including Acetyl Tetrapeptide-11 and Copper Tripeptide-1. This version contains fragrance and several fragrance allergens — worth noting for sensitive skin.
tabs.Применение: For the 50 ml version, the brand recommends using the serum morning and evening after toner and emulsion. Spread a small amount from the center of your face outward.

tabs.Характеристики: A light eye serum with a metal roller. The roller feels pleasantly cool and helps spread the product without stretching the delicate skin. It targets firmness, hydration and smoother-looking fine lines. The 10 ml size is easy to carry around.
tabs.Состав: Vegan collagen, three types of hyaluronic acid and a five-peptide complex. Collagen and peptides support firmness; hyaluronic acid hydrates and smooths.
tabs.Применение: Morning and evening after toner, roll under your eyes and over the upper lid from the inner corner outward. Tap in any residue with your fingertips. Wipe the roller after use and replace the cap.

tabs.Характеристики: A nourishing cream for firmer skin. Ginseng and ceramides strengthen the skin barrier, while fermented retinol gently targets early signs of aging. The texture is creamy but not heavy — suitable for daily use, including for retinol beginners.
tabs.Состав: Fermented retinol, ginseng ceramides and ginseng extract. Fermentation makes retinol gentler on the skin, while ceramides and ginseng nourish and support the barrier.
tabs.Применение: Apply to cleansed skin as the last step, evening or morning. Start by using it every other day so your skin can adjust. Always use sunscreen during the day.

tabs.Характеристики: A serum for firmer skin and smoother texture. A gentle concentration of retinol targets fine lines and enlarged pores, while peptides and panthenol make it more comfortable. A good first retinol.
tabs.Состав: 0.1% retinol, a nine-peptide complex and 1% panthenol. Retinol renews the skin, peptides support firmness, and panthenol soothes and hydrates.
tabs.Применение: In the evening after toner, apply 1–2 pumps to dry skin, avoiding the eye area. For the first two weeks use it every other night, then nightly. Follow with moisturizer; always use SPF in the morning.

tabs.Характеристики: A light booster serum applied as the first step after cleansing. Six peptides support firmness and smoothness, while hyaluronic acid and amino acids hydrate. It helps the next products spread better and evens out skin tone.
tabs.Состав: A six-peptide complex, hyaluronic acid, N-acetylglucosamine (NAG) and amino acids. Peptides support firmness, NAG an even tone, and hyaluronic acid and amino acids hydration.
tabs.Применение: Morning and evening after cleansing, apply 2–3 pumps to your face and press in with your palms. Then follow with toner, serum and cream as usual. Suitable for daily use.

tabs.Характеристики: A 0.5% retinol oil for skin that’s already used to retinoids. It targets wrinkles, loss of firmness and uneven texture. The oil base with vitamin E and squalane softens retinol’s effect and nourishes the skin.
tabs.Состав: 0.5% retinol, vitamin E and squalane. Retinol renews the skin, vitamin E protects it as an antioxidant, and squalane softens and locks in moisture.
tabs.Применение: Evenings only: 2–3 drops on dry, cleansed skin, avoiding the eye and lip area. Start with 2–3 times a week. If your skin is sensitive, mix it with cream. Always SPF during the day. Don’t use at the same time as acids.

tabs.Характеристики: A night ampoule that repairs your skin while you sleep. Fermented ingredients and probiotics support the skin barrier, and in the morning skin looks rested, firm and even. The light texture absorbs quickly.
tabs.Состав: The Extreme Biome complex of fermented ingredients and probiotics (77.2%), peptides and niacinamide. Ferments and probiotics repair the barrier, peptides support firmness, and niacinamide evens out tone.
tabs.Применение: In the evening after toner, apply 2–3 drops to your face and press in gently with your palms. Then apply cream. Suitable for daily use.

tabs.Характеристики: An ampoule for skin renewal and post-breakout marks. The light texture won’t weigh down your routine.
tabs.Состав: Retinol, centella asiatica (cica) and soothing plant extracts. Retinol renews skin; centella calms redness and supports recovery.
tabs.Применение: In the evening after toner, apply 1–2 pumps to dry skin. Start every other day, then nightly. Follow with moisturizer; SPF in the morning.

tabs.Характеристики: A targeted corrector cream for visible wrinkles: on the forehead, between the brows, along nasolabial folds and around the eyes. Stabilized retinol works on wrinkle depth, and the applicator tip helps place the product exactly where needed.
tabs.Состав: 0.1% stabilized retinol plus caring and softening ingredients. Retinol renews skin and helps smooth wrinkles.
tabs.Применение: In the evening, apply a small amount to areas with wrinkles and spread gently. Start with 2–3 times a week, then use nightly. Always SPF during the day.

laneige-perfect-renew-serum.description: Anti-aging serum for firmness and glow

tabs.Состав: Retinol, peptides and vitamin C — each in its own chamber. Retinol smooths, peptides support firmness, and vitamin C adds radiance.
tabs.Применение: Morning and evening after toner, apply 1–2 pumps to your face and neck and spread with light strokes. Then apply cream. Always SPF during the day.

tabs.Характеристики: A rich, nourishing cream for firm, smooth skin. Collagen helps retain moisture and smooths the look of fine lines. Great for evening care and for dry skin in the cold season.
tabs.Состав: Collagen (about 54% of the formula) plus hydrating and nourishing ingredients. Collagen locks in moisture and makes skin smoother and firmer.
tabs.Применение: Apply as the last step morning or evening, spreading over your face and neck with upward strokes. For dry skin, apply a thicker layer in the evening as a sleeping mask.

tabs.Характеристики: Thin patches that gradually “melt” on the skin, releasing caring ingredients. Great for areas losing firmness and showing fine lines: under the eyes, along nasolabial folds, on the forehead. Visibly smoother, radiant skin by morning.
tabs.Состав: PDRN, collagen and hyaluronic acid. PDRN supports skin recovery, collagen firmness, and hyaluronic acid hydrates and smooths.
tabs.Применение: In the evening after your routine, apply the patches to dry skin on the areas you want to treat and leave overnight or for a few hours. Remove in the morning and wash your face. Use 2–3 times a week.

anua-pdrn-capsule-mist.description: PDRN and hyaluronic acid capsule mist

tabs.Характеристики: A hydrating mist with capsules that burst as you spray. It refreshes and hydrates skin throughout the day, works over makeup and as a skincare step after cleansing. Leaves a light glow without stickiness.
tabs.Состав: PDRN and encapsulated hyaluronic acid. PDRN supports skin recovery; hyaluronic acid hydrates instantly.
tabs.Применение: Shake the bottle to distribute the capsules and spray onto your face from 20–30 cm. Use after cleansing, before cream, or during the day whenever your skin needs hydration.

anua-pdrn-booster-toner.description: PDRN and hyaluronic acid booster toner

tabs.Характеристики: A hydrating booster toner: it preps skin for the next steps and helps serums and creams spread better. Leaves skin soft, nourished and radiant. The light, watery texture suits all skin types.
tabs.Состав: PDRN and several types of hyaluronic acid. PDRN supports recovery and firmness; hyaluronic acid hydrates different layers of the skin.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing, apply the toner with your palms or a cotton pad and pat in lightly. For intense hydration, apply 2–3 layers. Then serum and cream.

tabs.Характеристики: A gentle daily cleansing foam that cleanses without leaving skin tight. Great for your morning cleanse and as the second step of evening cleansing after an oil.
tabs.Состав: PDRN, hyaluronic acid and gentle cleansing agents. Hyaluronic acid keeps skin hydrated while you cleanse.
tabs.Применение: Lather a small amount with water in your palms, massage over damp skin for 30–60 seconds and rinse with warm water. Use morning and evening, then follow with toner.

tabs.Характеристики: A PDRN serum in single-use 1 ml ampoules — a 10-treatment course. Easy to take on trips and use as an intensive recovery course.
tabs.Состав: PDRN, hyaluronic acid and hydrating capsules. PDRN supports skin recovery and firmness; hyaluronic acid hydrates.
tabs.Применение: In the evening after toner, open one ampoule and spread the serum over your face, tapping it in gently with your fingertips. Then apply cream. Use for 10 days in a row or every other day.

tabs.Характеристики: A milky toner for radiant, soft skin. The gentle texture hydrates and nourishes, leaving skin even and “lit from within”. Great for dry and normal skin, especially in the cold season.
tabs.Состав: Rice extract (70%) and ceramides. Rice evens out tone and adds radiance; ceramides support the skin barrier and lock in moisture.
tabs.Применение: Shake the bottle. After cleansing, apply the toner with your palms and pat it in. Then serum and cream.

tabs.Характеристики: A rich soothing cream for sensitive and irritated skin. It relieves discomfort and redness and repairs the skin barrier. A richer version of the classic Heartleaf 70 cream — great for dry skin and the cold season.
tabs.Состав: Heartleaf extract (70%) and ceramides. Heartleaf soothes and calms redness; ceramides repair the barrier and lock in moisture.
tabs.Применение: Apply as the last step morning and evening. Add a second layer on especially dry areas.

tabs.Характеристики: A cream that repairs the skin barrier. Ideal when skin is flaky, tight or irritated after active products. The soft texture nourishes without leaving a greasy film.
tabs.Состав: Three types of ceramides and panthenol. Ceramides repair the barrier and lock in moisture; panthenol soothes and helps skin recover.
tabs.Применение: Apply as the last step morning and evening. Pairs well with retinol and acids — apply it after them to soften their effect.

tabs.Состав: Peach extract (77%) and niacinamide. Peach softens and hydrates; niacinamide evens out tone and adds radiance.
tabs.Применение: After toner and serum, spread a small amount over your face. For dry skin, top with cream. Use morning and evening.

tabs.Характеристики: Pads for pore care and gentle exfoliation. They clear pores, smooth texture and soothe skin. Gentle PHA suits even sensitive skin.
tabs.Состав: Heartleaf extract (77%) and PHA. Heartleaf soothes and calms redness; PHA gently exfoliates and clears pores.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing, wipe your face with a pad along massage lines, focusing on areas with enlarged pores. Then toner or serum. Use once a day; every other day for sensitive skin.

anua-niacinamide-txa-pad.description: Niacinamide and tranexamic acid brightening pads

tabs.Характеристики: Brightening pads for an even tone: they target dark spots, post-acne marks and dullness. Use them daily as a toner or as a short mask on problem areas.
tabs.Состав: 5% niacinamide and tranexamic acid (TXA). Niacinamide evens out tone and strengthens the barrier; TXA helps fade pigmentation.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing, wipe your face with a pad. Place a pad on dark spots for 5–10 minutes as a mask. Then serum and cream. Always SPF during the day.

tabs.Характеристики: A cream for targeting dark spots, post-acne marks and uneven tone. The light white texture absorbs quickly and suits daily use.
tabs.Состав: 3% tranexamic acid and 3% niacinamide brighten spots and even out tone; licorice root water soothes the skin.
tabs.Применение: Apply morning and evening as the last step, all over your face or directly onto spots. Always SPF during the day.

tabs.Характеристики: A mist with a creamy texture — the soothing 345 cream in spray form. It instantly hydrates and relieves tightness; refresh your face throughout the day, even over makeup.
tabs.Состав: Three types of hyaluronic acid, four rice-derived ingredients and five soothing ones — centella, aloe, panthenol and more.
tabs.Применение: Shake and spray onto your face from 20–30 cm after cleansing or during the day. Pat with your palms to help it absorb.

tabs.Характеристики: A gentle, mildly acidic gel (pH 5–6) for daily cleansing. It cleanses, lightly renews skin and doesn’t leave it tight — suitable even for sensitive skin.
tabs.Состав: Enzymes and mild acids for gentle renewal, betaine, ceramides and hyaluronic acid for hydration, and tea tree and centella for soothing.
tabs.Применение: Lather a little gel with water, massage over damp skin for 30–60 seconds and rinse. Use morning and evening.

dr-althea-147-barrier-cream.description: Barrier cream for dry skin, 15 ml

tabs.Характеристики: A cream for normal and dry skin that needs protection: after peels, retinol, in frost and wind. It repairs the barrier and keeps skin hydrated for a long time. Handy 15 ml mini size.
tabs.Состав: Ectoin, ceramides, betaine and betulin protect the barrier, and seven types of hyaluronic acid hydrate.
tabs.Применение: Apply as the last step morning and evening. Add a second layer on especially dry areas.

tabs.Характеристики: A light cleansing oil with a “watery” texture: it dissolves makeup, SPF and sebum in pores, rinses off easily and leaves no film. Gentle even on sensitive skin.
tabs.Состав: Light plant oils and mild emulsifiers that turn the oil into a milk on contact with water.
tabs.Применение: Apply 2–3 pumps to dry skin and massage, then add a little water until milky and rinse. Follow with a gel cleanser.

tabs.Характеристики: A first-step cleansing balm that melts with the warmth of your hands and dissolves makeup, SPF and sebum. The jar has a built-in grinder that dispenses just the right amount — no dirty fingers in the jar. Rinses off easily without a greasy film.
tabs.Состав: Camellia seed and grapeseed oils dissolve impurities, while centella and its actives (madecassoside, asiaticoside) soothe the skin.
tabs.Применение: Twist the grinder lid to dispense a little balm. Spread over dry skin and massage, then add a little water — the balm will turn milky. Rinse and follow with a gel cleanser.

tabs.Характеристики: A serum for glow and an even tone that suits even sensitive skin. Instead of harsh pure vitamin C, it uses sea buckthorn — a natural source of vitamin C — so skin looks fresh and rested without stinging.
tabs.Состав: 63% sea buckthorn water — a vitamin C-rich extract that adds radiance and evens out tone.
tabs.Применение: Morning or evening after toner, apply 2–3 drops to your face and tap in gently. Then cream. Always SPF during the day.

elizavecca-galactomyces-ample.description: Galactomyces ampoule for glow and an even tone, 50 ml

tabs.Характеристики: An ampoule with a high concentration of galactomyces ferment filtrate — a fermented ingredient that makes skin more even and radiant. It helps refine pores, evens out tone and preps skin for the next steps.
tabs.Применение: After toner, apply 2–3 drops to your face and tap in with your fingertips. Then cream. Morning and evening.

elizavecca-wine-peeling-pad.description: Wine extract peeling pads for pores

tabs.Характеристики: Pads for gentle exfoliation and pore cleansing: they remove dead skin, smooth texture and give skin a fresh look. Double-sided — the textured side for peeling, the smooth side for soothing.
tabs.Применение: After cleansing, wipe your face with the textured side, then the smooth side. Use 2–3 times a week; SPF during the day.

tabs.Характеристики: A gentle gel for daily cleansing of sensitive skin. It cleanses without drying or leaving skin tight. Handy pump.
tabs.Состав: Centella asiatica soothes and calms redness, and gentle cleansing agents carefully remove impurities.
tabs.Применение: Lather a little gel with water, massage over damp skin and rinse. Morning and evening.

erborian-centella-barrier-cream.description: Repairing centella and ceramide cream, 50 ml

tabs.Характеристики: A cream-balm for express repair of irritated, over-dried skin. It soothes, strengthens the skin barrier and relieves discomfort — great after active products and in the cold season.
tabs.Применение: Apply as the last step all over your face or on irritated areas, morning and evening.

tabs.Характеристики: A jelly cream-pack you can leave on the skin after applying — no rinsing needed. The brand describes it as collagen care and registers it as functional cosmetics for visible wrinkles. Great as a richer final step when skin craves extra hydration and softness.
tabs.Применение: Scoop an appropriate amount with the spatula and apply to cleansed skin after toner. Massage lightly for about two minutes, then press gently with your palms until absorbed. No need to rinse. Don’t apply to broken or inflamed skin; if itching, swelling or persistent irritation occurs, stop using it and seek advice.

tabs.Характеристики: A gentle body and hair wash for everyday use. The foam washes away impurities and is designed so skin doesn’t feel overly dry afterwards. Available in 500 and 1,000 ml bottles and refills.
tabs.Применение: Apply a small amount to wet skin or hair, lather with your hands or a sponge and rinse thoroughly. For hair, work the foam into your scalp and hair, then rinse well. If it gets in your eyes, rinse with water; if irritation appears, use it less often or stop.

tabs.Характеристики: A shower gel for daily body cleansing with a soft Baby Powder scent. The fragrance includes lavender and geranium accents with musky-woody notes. Comes in a bottle of about 910 ml.
tabs.Состав: Contains the cleansing agents sodium laureth sulfate and cocamidopropyl betaine, sorbitol, panthenol, citric acid and fragrance. Sorbitol and panthenol add softening care to the cleansing base. Fragrance allergens are also listed, including citronellol and coumarin.
tabs.Применение: Apply a small amount to a wet washcloth or your palms, lather and spread over your body with gentle movements. Rinse thoroughly. Avoid contact with the eyes. If your skin tends to be dry or reacts to scented products, start with a small amount and stop if you feel discomfort.

tabs.Характеристики: A daily body wash with a White Musk scent. The foam helps rinse away impurities and sweat, while aloe, honey and plant extracts add softening care. White Musk is described as a soft, clean musky scent. The typical bottle size is 500 ml; packaging and formula may be updated.
tabs.Состав: The ingredient list includes cleansing agents, glycerin, aloe, honey and macadamia extracts, sodium hyaluronate, coconut, camellia and jojoba oils, and plant extracts. Fragrance creates the White Musk scent.
tabs.Применение: Apply a little gel to a wet sponge or your palms, lather and spread the foam over your body, focusing on areas that need cleansing. Rinse thoroughly. Repeat if needed. Rinse the sponge after use and let it dry. Avoid contact with the eyes and stop if irritation appears.

tabs.Характеристики: A body wash with an AHA, BHA and PHA acid complex for oily areas prone to blemishes. 400 g. It rinses off, but frequent use can dry the skin.
tabs.Применение: Apply a little product to a wet sponge or your palms, lather and spread gently over your body, then rinse thoroughly with warm water. Start with once a day or less, especially if your skin tends to be dry. If you notice tightness, flaking or irritation, use it less often or stop. Don’t apply to broken skin.

tabs.Характеристики: A body shower cleanser with exfoliating particles. It helps wash away impurities and makes skin feel smoother. Usually sold in a 400 ml size; some sets include a larger bottle or extra format. Unlike an intensive scrub in a jar, this is a rinse-off shower product.
tabs.Применение: Apply to wet skin in the shower, lather and massage without pressing hard, then rinse thoroughly with warm water. Don’t use on irritated or broken skin or right after shaving. With sensitive skin, start with occasional use and watch the reaction; don’t combine it on the same day with other intensive exfoliants on the same area.

tabs.Характеристики: A rinse-off sugar scrub mask for gentle exfoliation and smoother-feeling skin. The formula contains oils that soften the skin during massage. On the body, use it on rough patches without pressing too hard.
tabs.Состав: Sucrose forms the exfoliating texture. Glycerin, macadamia, meadowfoam, shea, evening primrose, olive and jojoba oils soften the skin. The list also includes rice ferment, fruit extracts and fragrance. Contains lanolin and fragrance components — keep this in mind when choosing.
tabs.Применение: Apply a small amount to damp skin and massage the area very gently, avoiding broken skin. Then rinse thoroughly with warm water. No need to scrub hard; stop if it feels unpleasant. For the face, follow the brand’s separate instructions and avoid the eye and lip area.

tabs.Характеристики: A rich, concentrated cream for dry skin, made for areas that need more intensive softening. The formula leaves a protective, comfortable feel and suits spot care of very dry body areas.
tabs.Состав: The formula is topped up with ginseng root water and plant extracts. This cream’s formula has been updated over time.
tabs.Применение: Apply a small amount to clean, dry skin and spread until comfortably covered. Use on dry body areas or as a final moisturizing step where a richer texture is needed.

tabs.Характеристики: A moisturizing body lotion for dry and sensitive skin. The brand describes it as support for the skin barrier and long-lasting comfort: it helps relieve dryness and soften rough patches. The texture spreads easily over large areas for daily after-shower care. The international version is 400 ml.
tabs.Состав: The ingredient list includes the humectants glycerin and propanediol, squalane, panthenol, acetyl glucosamine, gluconolactone and ceramide NP — a softening base with ingredients for hydration and smoother-looking skin. The brand also highlights that the published international version is fragrance-free.
tabs.Применение: Apply the lotion after a shower while skin is still slightly damp, or to dry skin during the day. Spread over arms, legs and other areas that need extra hydration with gentle massaging movements until absorbed. Use more on especially dry spots. Avoid applying to broken or irritated skin.

tabs.Характеристики: A moisturizing daily body lotion with a soft, warm, musky White Musk scent. The light creamy texture spreads easily and softens skin after a shower without feeling heavy. The brand’s bottle size is 500 ml. Perfect if you want basic hydration with a fragrance.
tabs.Состав: The White Musk version lists aloe, glycerin, niacinamide, honey and macadamia extract, plus jojoba, meadowfoam and camellia oils, in a softening emulsion base with fragrance. These ingredients care for dry skin; the scented formula may not suit people sensitive to fragrance.
tabs.Применение: Spread the lotion over clean skin after a shower or whenever your skin feels dry. Apply to arms, legs and other areas with gentle strokes until absorbed. For a stronger scent, apply after bathing, but let your skin dry first. Don’t apply to broken skin.

tabs.Характеристики: A daily moisturizing lotion with a lighter texture than the series’ concentrated cream. Easy to apply over large areas of the body if your skin tends to be dry and needs regular softening. It spreads thinly and leaves skin comfortable.
tabs.Состав: Also contains ginseng root water and plant extracts, including perilla. Formulas may be updated.
tabs.Применение: Apply after a shower to clean skin, especially dry areas of the arms and legs. Spread gently until absorbed; reapply where skin loses moisture quickly. Suitable for regular use. Don’t apply to broken skin.

tabs.Характеристики: It softens dry skin and leaves it feeling cared for without a heavy, greasy finish. The scent pairs soft floral magnolia notes with warm sandalwood. Great for regular use, especially after an evening shower. 200 g.
tabs.Состав: Contains shea, evening primrose, meadowfoam, sweet almond, olive, sunflower and jojoba oils, plus glycerin, ectoin and ceramide NP. Magnolia, sandalwood, jasmine and geranium essential oils create the scent.
tabs.Применение: After a shower, pat your skin with a towel, leaving it slightly damp. Take an appropriate amount of cream and spread it over your body with massaging movements, then pat lightly to help it absorb. For richer care, focus on dry areas of the arms and legs.

tabs.Характеристики: A light body mist with a herbal citrus scent. It features basil and bergamot, with green woody notes of cypress and patchouli in the drydown. The watery texture refreshes skin quickly without leaving a heavy layer. 120 ml.
tabs.Состав: Contains alcohol and basil, bergamot, cypress and patchouli aromatic oils.
tabs.Применение: After a shower, spray onto clean, dry skin from about 20 cm, focusing on the areas you want, and let it dry. Don’t spray into the eyes, on mucous membranes or broken skin; if your skin is sensitive, start with a small area.

tabs.Характеристики: A perfumed body mist with the Ice Orange Blossom scent — a cool take on a citrus-floral bouquet. The main note is orange blossom, accented with bright citrus. The fine spray leaves a light layer of fragrance and is perfect for refreshing your scent during the day. Sold in a 150 ml size.
tabs.Применение: Spray onto your body from a comfortable distance after a shower or whenever you want to refresh the scent. Avoid the face, eyes, mucous membranes and irritated skin. Let it dry before it touches fabric.

tabs.Характеристики: A light perfumed body mist with a soft, sweet floral-fruity scent. It leaves a delicate fragrance and a light feeling of freshness. Great for refreshing your scent after a shower or during the day.
tabs.Состав: Contains elderflower water, alcohol, betaine, panthenol, sodium hyaluronate and fragrance. The formula includes perfume components and potential fragrance allergens.
tabs.Применение: Spray onto clean, dry skin after a shower or onto chosen areas whenever you want to refresh the scent. Don’t spray into your face, eyes or mucous membranes. Let it dry before dressing; with sensitive skin, test on a small area first.

tabs.Характеристики: A scented body mist with a light spray that refreshes skin and leaves a soft White Musk trail. 128 ml. The scent is described as warm and clean musk; intensity and longevity depend on your skin and how much you apply.
tabs.Состав: Also contains plant extracts and fragrance with fragrance allergens.
tabs.Применение: Spray onto your body from a short distance after a shower or during the day, avoiding the face, eyes and mucous membranes. Let it dry. You can also spray it on clothing — check first that it doesn’t mark the fabric. Don’t use on irritated or broken skin.

tabs.Характеристики: A two-phase body mist with a water and an oil phase that refreshes skin and helps keep it feeling soft. The brand links the formula to a fermented seaweed complex; shake to mix the layers for an even spray. Light texture with no heavy, sticky coating. Available in 160 ml bottles.
tabs.Состав: The formula is rounded out with hydrating ingredients and plant oils that create the two-phase texture.
tabs.Применение: Shake the bottle well before use to combine the water and oil phases. Spray onto your body from a comfortable distance and spread gently with your palms. Don’t spray directly into your face, eyes or mucous membranes. With sensitive skin, start with a small area; don’t apply to broken skin.

tabs.Характеристики: A shampoo that cleanses hair and scalp with extra protein care for the lengths. The brand targets dry, damaged hair that you want to look smoother and more cared-for after washing. Features a complex of hydrolyzed proteins and keratin.
tabs.Состав: The formula combines cleansing agents with humectants and protein ingredients. The official description mentions betaine, hydrolyzed proteins and keratin; softening oils are also included.
tabs.Применение: Wet your hair and scalp, lather a small amount of shampoo with massaging movements, then rinse thoroughly. Repeat if needed. Try not to tangle the lengths while lathering — just spread the foam gently through your hair. After cleansing, use conditioner or a mask if your lengths need extra softening.

tabs.Характеристики: A shampoo for cleansing scalp and hair with the Angel Muguet scent. The brand describes this perfumed series as protein care for damaged lengths; this shampoo features a hydrolyzed protein complex.
tabs.Состав: The formula’s key features are a cleansing base and a protein complex; the brand specifically mentions keratin and hydrolyzed proteins. The product is scented, and Angel Muguet is described as floral.
tabs.Применение: Apply a small amount to thoroughly wet hair and scalp, lather with massaging movements, then rinse thoroughly. Repeat if needed. For dry or damaged lengths, follow with conditioner or a mask, applying them mainly to the lengths.

tabs.Характеристики: A cleansing shampoo for hair and a scalp troubled by dryness, itching or visible flakes.
tabs.Состав: The official page lists a cleansing base, piroctone olamine and lavender, mint, chamomile and rosemary extracts, plus conditioning polymers and fragrance. These ingredients shape the shampoo’s properties but don’t mean it treats scalp conditions.
tabs.Применение: Apply an appropriate amount to a damp scalp and hair, massage gently into a lather, then rinse thoroughly with warm water. Repeat if needed. Make sure no product is left on your hair and skin after the shower. For dry lengths, add conditioner through the lengths.

tabs.Характеристики: A cleansing shampoo for a scalp prone to sensitivity, itching or discomfort. The formula contains tea tree oil, and the brand also lists soothing plant extracts. Rinse it out completely after washing. The official page confirms a 330 ml size and highlights the product as specialized scalp care.
tabs.Применение: Apply to thoroughly wet scalp and hair, lather with gentle massaging movements, then rinse completely. Don’t leave the shampoo on your skin or hair; the brand specifically warns to rinse thoroughly. If it gets in your eyes, rinse with water. If irritation persists, stop using it and consult a specialist.

tabs.Характеристики: A rinse-off conditioner for dry, weakened hair, including after coloring or perming. The Damage Protector Acid line is for hair that needs smoothness and a more polished look after salon treatments. The official set description promises shine support and helps hair look less tangled.
tabs.Состав: The brand’s published ingredient list includes softening conditioning agents, silicones, hydrolyzed silk and mint, thuja and soapberry extracts, as well as yeast peptide and copper tripeptide-1. Citric acid is also listed.
tabs.Применение: After shampooing, spread the conditioner through damp lengths, avoiding the eyes. For fine hair, use less product and apply mainly to the ends.

tabs.Характеристики: An intensive rinse-off treatment for dry, brittle and damaged hair. It softens the lengths, helps make them smoother and makes detangling easier. The Hydro LPP formula is built around protein care; the brand positions it for hair lacking elasticity and a well-kept look.
tabs.Состав: Features hydrolyzed proteins, including keratin and silk, plus softening and hydrating ingredients. Proteins help the lengths feel denser and smoother, and the conditioning base reduces tangling. This is cosmetic care, not a permanent fix for hair structure.
tabs.Применение: After shampooing, squeeze out excess water and spread the treatment through the lengths, especially on dry or damaged areas. Leave for a few minutes like a regular conditioner, then rinse thoroughly. For more intensive care, leave it on longer within the brand’s instructions. Don’t apply to the face or eyes; for short or fine hair, start with less.

tabs.Характеристики: A rinse-off hair treatment with the Osmanthus scent that softens the lengths and helps with detangling. The brand links its perfumed treatments to protein care for dry, damaged hair. Afterwards, hair is smoother and carries a signature osmanthus scent.
tabs.Состав: The brand lists hydrolyzed proteins and ceramides plus conditioning ingredients for the series. They help soften the hair surface and relieve dryness. Osmanthus is the scent, not an ingredient with claimed therapeutic effects.
tabs.Применение: After shampooing, spread an appropriate amount through damp lengths and ends, leave for about 3–5 minutes, then rinse thoroughly. Avoid applying too close to the roots if your hair loses volume easily. Keep it out of your eyes.

tabs.Характеристики: A leave-in treatment in a fine-mist spray for dry, dull and damaged hair. The formula adds hydration and supports smoothness without rinsing. The official description highlights a complex of hydrolyzed proteins, including collagen, silk and keratin. The official version is 200 ml.
tabs.Состав: Contains hydrolyzed collagen, silk, keratin and elastin plus a keratin-based ferment. Glycerin, hemp, castor and camellia seed oils, sodium hyaluronate and ceramide NP soften the formula. The brand also lists plant extracts, including green tea and seaweed.
tabs.Применение: Shake the bottle well before use. Spray from about 10–20 cm onto the lengths and ends; the brand allows reapplying whenever hair feels dry.

tabs.Характеристики: A multi-purpose creamy hair treatment you can use as a quick rinse-off treatment or as a leave-in for the lengths. Wonder Balm is designed for dry, damaged hair: it softens, reduces tangling and gives a smoother look. The brand describes it as protein moisturizing care. The official size is 200 ml.
tabs.Состав: The brand highlights silk proteins, macadamia, ceramides and amino acids. The conditioning base softens the lengths, and the proteins round out care for hair damaged by coloring or styling.
tabs.Применение: For a quick rinse-off treatment, spread through damp hair after shampooing, leave for about 50 seconds and rinse. For more intensive use, leave for 5–10 minutes before rinsing. As a leave-in cream, apply a small amount to damp lengths and don’t rinse; start with a tiny amount so as not to weigh hair down.

tabs.Характеристики: A perfumed oil for the lengths that softens dry areas and adds shine. Use it as a finishing touch after styling or on the ends whenever they need smoothing.
tabs.Состав: The oil base uses softening ingredients and plant oils. With Angel Muguet, the floral perfume composition matters too. Apply a little at a time to find the right amount for your hair’s thickness and porosity.
tabs.Применение: Rub a small amount of oil between your palms and spread through damp or dry hair, focusing on the lengths and ends. Start with the smallest amount and add more if needed. Don’t apply too much at the roots if your hair loses volume easily. The official page lists it as a finishing product.

tabs.Характеристики: An oil for the lengths and ends with an osmanthus scent. It gives hair a smoother look and shine and softens dry areas. Works as a small finishing step in styling; with fine hair, it’s especially important to build up the amount gradually.
tabs.Состав: The oil has a softening base and the Osmanthus perfume composition; the brand also lists plant oils and hair-softening ingredients. It’s mainly a leave-in finishing product for the lengths.
tabs.Применение: Put a few drops in your palms, rub them together and spread through damp or dry hair, avoiding the roots. Start with the smallest amount, especially if your hair is fine or gets heavy easily. If needed, add more oil only to the ends.

tabs.Характеристики: An SPF50+ PA++++ sun serum combining chemical filters with hydrating care. The brand’s official page says it’s suitable for daily use and different skin types, including sensitive skin.
tabs.Применение: Apply evenly to your face before going out in the sun as the final step of your morning routine. When outdoors for long periods, reapply regularly and after water, sweat or towel-drying. For the stated protection, don’t apply too thin a layer.

tabs.Характеристики: A portable SPF50+ PA++++ sunscreen stick for easy reapplication throughout the day. Handy when you’re out; don’t rely on a thin stick layer alone for your first morning coverage.
tabs.Состав: Based on chemical UV filters. The formula includes several forms of hyaluronic acid, panthenol, squalane and ceramide NP, plus centella and plant extracts.
tabs.Применение: Use as the final step before going out in the sun and to reapply during the day. Glide the stick over exposed skin in even passes without missing any areas. Use enough product for the first application; reapply after sweat, water and towel-drying.

anua-glow-sunstick.description: Invisible sunstick with a dewy finish

tabs.Характеристики: A compact stick for applying and reapplying sunscreen during the day. The clear gel texture is designed to leave no visible white cast and give skin a hydrated finish. Perfect for travel and touch-ups over makeup.
tabs.Состав: Anua’s published list includes chemical UV filters, panthenol, glycerin, ceramide NP and several forms of hyaluronic acid, adding softening and hydrating care to the sunscreen base.
tabs.Применение: Glide the stick evenly over your skin without missing exposed areas. For your first morning application, it’s easier to spread enough sunscreen by hand and use the stick for reapplying.

boj-relief-sun.description: Light rice and probiotic sunscreen, 50 ml

tabs.Характеристики: Korea’s most famous sunscreen: light as a moisturizer, no white cast and no stickiness. Works under makeup and for everyday city wear. High SPF50+ PA++++ protection.
tabs.Состав: Rice extract and probiotics hydrate and soothe skin; chemical filters protect against UVA and UVB.
tabs.Применение: Apply as the last step of your morning routine 15 minutes before going out — about two finger-lengths for the face. Reapply every 2–3 hours in the sun.

tabs.Характеристики: A moisturizing sunscreen for dry and normal skin: a soft creamy texture, no tightness and no white cast.
tabs.Состав: Birch sap hydrates and refreshes, hyaluronic acid locks in moisture, and chemical filters protect from the sun.

isntree-watery-sun-gel.description: Light hyaluronic acid sun gel, 50 ml

tabs.Характеристики: A light gel sunscreen with a “watery” texture — ideal for oily and combination skin and hot weather. Absorbs quickly, leaves no white cast and doesn’t clog pores.
tabs.Состав: Eight types of hyaluronic acid hydrate, and chemical filters protect against UVA and UVB.

missha-vita-c-sunscreen.description: Vitamin C face and body sunscreen, 70 ml

tabs.Характеристики: A vitamin C sunscreen for face and body: it protects from the sun and gives skin a glow. The handy 70 ml bottle covers your hands, neck and shoulders too.
tabs.Состав: Vitamin C evens out tone and adds radiance; broad-spectrum filters protect against UVA and UVB.
tabs.Применение: Shake the bottle. Apply to your face and exposed body areas 15 minutes before going out in the sun. Reapply every 2–3 hours and after swimming.

tabs.Характеристики: A water-resistant sunscreen stick (80 minutes in water): easy to reapply over makeup and take with you. It glides on smoothly, evens out skin texture and leaves no greasy shine.
tabs.Применение: Glide the stick over your face and exposed areas 2–3 times, then blend lightly with your fingers. Reapply every 2 hours and after swimming.

tabs.Характеристики: A mineral cream that protects skin from UVA and UVB rays, including sensitive skin.
tabs.Применение: Apply a generous amount to your face and other exposed skin before sun exposure. Spread evenly, without missing the hairline and neck. Reapply during the day and after water or sweat.
Spread a generous amount over your face and neck as the last step before going out in the sun. Reapply when outdoors for long periods and after sweat, water or towel-drying.

tabs.Характеристики: A mineral cream for daily UVA and UVB protection with zinc oxide. The official V.3 version has SPF 50 and PA++++, comes in 50 ml, has a light gel-cream texture and claims a minimal white cast. The brand lists 2% niacinamide and positions the formula as suitable for sensitive skin.
tabs.Состав: The main mineral filter is zinc oxide. The formula also lists 2% niacinamide, squalane, sodium hyaluronate, calendula, green tea, mugwort and chamomile water.
tabs.Применение: Apply evenly to your face and neck as the last step of your morning routine. Reapply during the day, especially after sweat, water or towel-drying; follow the directions on the tube.

tabs.Характеристики: A lightweight sunscreen with a clear finish and SPF50 PA++++. COSRX describes it as fast-absorbing with no greasy feel and no noticeable white cast. The official version is 50 ml. The formula combines modern organic filters with a hydrating base.
tabs.Состав: UV protection comes from chemical filters including Ethylhexyl Triazone and Diethylamino Hydroxybenzoyl Hexyl Benzoate. The full list also includes sodium hyaluronate and allantoin.
tabs.Применение: Apply an even layer before going out in the sun as the final step of your routine. The brand recommends reapplying regularly, especially after swimming, sweating or towel-drying. For the stated protection, use enough product and cover all exposed skin.

tabs.Состав: The formula uses chemical UV filters, five types of ceramides, panthenol and centella, plus bisabolol, cholesterol and hydrating ingredients.
tabs.Применение: Apply in the morning as the last step to your face and neck. PURITO recommends reapplying about every 2–3 hours when you’re outdoors for long periods. Reapply after swimming, heavy sweating or towel-drying.

tabs.Характеристики: A broad-spectrum SPF50+ PA++++ sunscreen with soothing, hydrating care. The retailer lists a 50 ml size.
tabs.Состав: Retail descriptions of Skin Relief mention niacinamide, glycerin and centella.
tabs.Применение: Spread over your face and neck before sun exposure. Apply enough to cover skin evenly and reapply during the day, especially after swimming, sweating or towel-drying.

tabs.Характеристики: The official site describes a fast-absorbing, hydrating finish with no stickiness or white cast. Available in 15, 50 and 100 ml and as a set.
tabs.Состав: Chemical filters provide sun protection. As caring ingredients, SKIN1004 lists centella, hyaluronic acid, niacinamide and plant extracts.
tabs.Применение: Apply a generous amount to your face and neck as the last step of your morning routine. Spread evenly before going out in the sun and reapply during the day, especially after swimming, sweating or towel-drying.
Apply as the last step of your morning routine to exposed skin before sun exposure. Use enough product and reapply regularly.

tabs.Характеристики: An everyday SPF50+ PA++++ sunscreen with a light finish the brand describes as velvety and not too greasy. The Unscented version is 50 ml.
tabs.Состав: The official list includes niacinamide, rice bran oil, rice extract, ceramide NP, squalane and plant extracts. Several organic UV filters provide protection. The line has different editions, with and without fragrance.
tabs.Применение: Apply evenly to your face and neck as the last step of your morning routine before sun exposure. Don’t skimp to get the stated protection, and reapply during the day, especially after sweating or towel-drying.

tabs.Характеристики: A face sun essence with a light, hydrating texture. The official store lists 50 ml; the description classes it as SPF50+ PA++++ and highlights its high share of hydrating essence.
tabs.Состав: The formula contains modern chemical UV filters and hydrating ingredients. Published lists include glycerin, propanediol and the essence base.
tabs.Применение: Apply to your face and neck as the last step before going out in the sun, covering all exposed areas evenly. When outdoors for long periods, reapply, and apply again after swimming, sweating or towel-drying. Don’t replace your sunscreen layer with a regular moisturizer.

dasique-juicy-dewy-lip-tint.description: Juicy tint with a glossy finish

tabs.Характеристики: A tint with a dewy, radiant finish and a wide range of shades — from nudes to berries and corals. The shade and its intensity vary with your natural lip color.
tabs.Применение: Apply with the applicator from the center of your lips outward. For a softer effect, use a small amount and blend; add another layer if needed. Choose your shade in the palette before buying.

3ce-drop-glow-gel.description: Gel tint with a sheer glow

tabs.Характеристики: A glossy lip gel with sheer color and a plumping shine. The brand describes the formula as elastic and shiny; the base contains oils and emollients.
tabs.Состав: Contains diisostearyl malate, hydrogenated polyisobutene and caprylic/capric triglyceride — a softening oil base — plus tocopheryl acetate and flavor. Colorants vary by shade.
tabs.Применение: Apply with the applicator to clean lips from the center to the edges. Use one thin layer for a light shine or layer it over lip liner or lipstick.

amuse-jel-fit-tint.description: Jelly tint with a wet shine

tabs.Состав: The formula also contains a light oil and a film-forming ingredient for jelly coverage.
tabs.Применение: Apply a small amount directly to your lips with the applicator. For a sheer result, spread thinly; for brighter color, add a second layer. Let the glossy layer settle evenly.

tabs.Характеристики: A tint that gives lips rich color and a clear, mirror-like shine. The line comes in a wide palette; the result depends on the shade and your natural lip color.
tabs.Применение: Pick up an appropriate amount with the applicator and spread over your lips. For a neater outline, apply to the center first, then blend toward the edges. Close the cap tightly after use.

tabs.Характеристики: A lip tint with a dewier, more radiant finish than matte fixing tints. Gives sheer, buildable color.
tabs.Применение: Spread a thin layer over your lips with the applicator. For more intense color, apply a second layer once the first has settled evenly. Touch up during the day if needed.
Apply a thin layer with the applicator to clean lips or over lipstick. Spread evenly and add another layer if needed.

tabs.Характеристики: A jelly tint with a juicy shine and buildable color. Retail descriptions mention a formula with 42% hydrating essence, smooth glide and no heavy, sticky feel. The palette includes neutral, pink, peach and berry shades.
tabs.Применение: Apply a small amount to your lips with the applicator. For a sheer result, blend thinly; for bolder coverage, add a layer.

tabs.Характеристики: A colored tint with a smooth, gliding texture and a glassy shine. The Deep Glaze version has its own shade palette. Apply thinly or layer for more visible color and shine.
tabs.Применение: Apply to dry lips with the applicator, starting from the center. Spread thinly for a light tint or layer to the intensity you want. Don’t press your lips together right after applying to keep the gloss even.

tabs.Состав: This describes the cosmetic formula and visual effect; it’s not a medical promise of fuller lips.
tabs.Применение: Apply an appropriate amount with the applicator. A light layer gives more sheer color; extra layers intensify the shade and shine.

tabs.Характеристики: A tint with a glossy finish and a visibly fuller-lip effect. The formula combines color and shine; the shade is buildable.
tabs.Применение: Apply to your lips with the applicator, spreading from the center outward. To intensify color and shine, let the first layer set and add a little more. Pair it with lip liner, lipstick or a separate gloss.

tabs.Характеристики: A plumping gloss that visibly boosts lip volume and gives a juicy, glossy shine. A slight tingle after application means the plumping effect is working. Wear it alone or over lipstick and tint.
tabs.Состав: A plumping complex for visible volume and hydrating oils that care for lips and give a mirror shine.
tabs.Применение: Apply to your lips with the applicator on its own or over lipstick. For more volume, add a second layer to the center of the lower lip. The slight tingle fades after a few minutes.

tabs.Характеристики: A soft, creamy 2-in-1 for lips and cheeks with a blurred, soft-focus finish. The pudding texture blends easily with your fingers and looks natural, never patchy. Gives a light flush and soft lip color.
tabs.Состав: Blurring pigments and emollients that help the texture spread evenly without drying out lips.
tabs.Применение: For cheeks: pick up a little with your fingertip and pat it onto your cheekbones. For lips: apply to the center and blend outward for a gradient effect. Add another layer for brighter color.

tabs.Характеристики: A juicy 2-in-1 jelly for lips and cheeks with a radiant, dewy finish. It melts on contact, gives sheer color and creates a fresh flush and glossy lips. Easily buildable — from a light tint to rich color.
tabs.Состав: A jelly base with caring oils and pigments: it hydrates lips and doesn’t dry out the skin on your cheeks.
tabs.Применение: For lips: apply with your finger or straight from the pot and spread from the center outward. For cheeks: take a little on your fingertip and pat it onto your cheekbones. Add a second layer for brighter color.

fwee-mellow-dual-blush.description: Dual blush: a soft and a bright shade in one palette

tabs.Характеристики: A two-blush palette: a large soft shade for a light natural flush and a small bright one to add color to the center of the cheeks. The fine, silky texture blends easily and doesn’t emphasize pores. Wear the shades alone or mix them.
tabs.Состав: Soft powder pigments with a silky texture that apply evenly and don’t settle into pores.
tabs.Применение: Pick up the lighter shade with a brush or finger and blend over your cheekbones. For a more defined flush, add the bright shade to the center of your cheeks and gently blend the edges. The color is easily buildable.

tabs.Характеристики: A highlighter with gemstone-like shimmer: it gives a bright, dewy glow on the cheekbones, bridge of the nose and above the lip. The soft texture applies thinly, doesn’t emphasize pores and builds easily — from a subtle glow to a noticeable shine. The clear glitter compact is a jewel in itself.
tabs.Состав: Fine light-reflecting particles and glitter in a soft powder base that stays put on the skin.
tabs.Применение: Apply with your fingertip or a small brush to the tops of your cheekbones, the bridge of your nose, above your upper lip and the inner corners of your eyes. For an intense glow, pat on in several layers.

tabs.Характеристики: A gel tint with a juicy, wet shine and comfortable coverage without noticeable stickiness. Spread it thinly for a light tint or apply more densely.
tabs.Применение: Apply a moderate amount to your lips with the applicator and spread gently. For a natural result, blend the edges; for richer color, add another layer. Stop using it if irritation appears.

tabs.Характеристики: A sheer lip product halfway between a balm and color makeup. The line includes natural shades and separate “coolower” versions. Coverage is moderate and buildable.
tabs.Состав: Don’t confuse the Care Liptual formula with the separate nuse Color Care Lip Balm or Mousse Liptual.
tabs.Применение: Swipe the stick or applicator over your lips. Apply one layer for a light tint and repeat if needed. Reapply during the day like a tinted balm.

tabs.Характеристики: A rich lip gloss with color and a strong mirror shine. A wide palette that includes both basic shades and glittery ones.
tabs.Применение: For a richer shade, add a second layer. Blot off the excess with a tissue if you prefer a light finish.

tabs.Характеристики: A colored tint with juicy, glossy coverage that becomes more visible after application. A separate line from Glasting Water Tint and Glasting Color Gloss.
tabs.Состав: Contains raspberry seed oil, plum seed oil/extract, mango butter and several forms of hyaluronic acid.
tabs.Применение: Spread the color from the center of your lips outward and wait for the shine to appear. For more intense color, add another layer.
Apply to dry lips from the center outward. For a neater outline, use a lip liner; build intensity in layers.

tabs.Характеристики: A matte-finish lipstick from the Zero Matte line. Available in several shades.
tabs.Применение: Apply an even layer to your lips. For a soft gradient, blend the color from the center outward with your finger or a brush.

tabs.Характеристики: A pencil for defining the lip line and creating a color base. The shade depends on the version you choose.
tabs.Применение: Outline your lips with short strokes; if you like, fill in your whole lips with the pencil and apply lipstick or gloss on top.

unleashia-babe-skin-cushion.description: Light cushion with a glowy finish

tabs.Применение: Press the puff onto the cushion and pat the foundation on from the center of your face outward. Build up gradually.
Apply with the puff in small amounts using patting motions. Add coverage locally where needed.
Pick up product with the puff and pat it over your face. Build up coverage gradually, without rubbing.
Apply a small amount to your face and spread evenly with your fingers, a brush or a sponge. Add another layer to specific areas if needed.

tabs.Характеристики: Designed to even out skin tone; coverage and finish depend on the shade and current formula.
tabs.Применение: Spread a small amount over your skin in a thin layer. Build up gradually if you want more visible coverage.

tabs.Характеристики: A BB cream that evens out tone for a smoother-looking complexion. The ginseng line comes in several shades; coverage and tone depend on the version you choose.
tabs.Применение: Spread a small amount over your face with your fingers, a brush or a sponge. Start with a thin layer and add coverage where needed.

tabs.Характеристики: A mini version of Erborian’s famous BB cream — 15 ml, handy to take with you or to test a shade. A BB cream that evens out tone for a smoother-looking complexion. The ginseng line comes in several shades; coverage and tone depend on the version you choose.
tabs.Применение: Spread a small amount over your face with your fingers, a brush or a sponge. Start with a thin layer and add coverage where needed.

tabs.Характеристики: A tinted color-correcting face product in the CC Red version. The final shade and coverage depend on how much you apply.
tabs.Применение: Apply a small amount to clean, moisturized skin and spread evenly over your face. Add another layer to red areas if needed.
Apply a small amount to the apples of your cheeks or cheekbones and blend with a brush or sponge, adjusting the intensity gradually.

tabs.Характеристики: A compact powder for finishing your makeup and visibly smoothing the skin’s surface.
tabs.Применение: Pick up a small amount with a puff or brush and apply a thin layer, focusing on areas where makeup gets shiny faster.
Apply a thin layer with a puff or brush where you need powder. Don’t pick up too much product at once.
Lightly apply the powder to areas where makeup gets shiny faster. Use alone or over foundation.

tabs.Характеристики: A compact powder for finishing touches and a visibly smoother-looking complexion.
tabs.Применение: Apply a small amount with a puff or brush to areas where you want to set makeup. Blend the edges in a thin layer.

tabs.Характеристики: A spray for the final step of your makeup that sets the products you’ve applied.
tabs.Применение: Close your eyes and spray from the distance stated by the brand after finishing your makeup. Let it dry naturally.

tabs.Характеристики: An eyebrow pencil in Ash Brown. The updated Drawing Eye Brow Pro has a triangular tip for fine detailing and filling, with a spoolie at the other end. Ash Brown gives a cool brown look; the result depends on your natural hair color and pressure.
tabs.Применение: Brush your brows with the spoolie, then fill in the shape with light strokes. To mimic hairs, use short strokes in the direction of growth; brush again at the end to soften the lines.

tabs.Характеристики: A brow mascara with a slim brush for precise application to the hairs and detailing small areas. Choose a shade close to your hair color or one shade lighter for a soft effect.
tabs.Применение: Brush through the hairs with short strokes from the inner edge of the brow to the tail. Apply thinly at first, then add more if needed. Keep it out of your eyes and let it dry.

tabs.Характеристики: A setting product for styling brows in a pomade/gel format. The line includes a Clear version that shapes hairs without visibly adding color. Not to be confused with the brand’s tinted brow mascaras.
tabs.Применение: Apply a small amount to your brows and brush the hairs into the direction you want. For a more natural result, spread thinly; don’t leave excess on the skin around the brows. Let it dry.

tabs.Характеристики: A mechanical pencil for filling and shaping brows with a fine triangular tip. Great for drawing individual strokes and filling wider areas; there’s a spoolie on the other end for brushing.
tabs.Состав: The Classic Brown shade lists iron oxide pigments, mica, waxes and emollients. Colorants and their ratios vary by shade.
tabs.Применение: Fill gaps and define the shape of your brows with short, light strokes. Use light pressure for a natural effect and denser strokes where the hairs are darker. Then brush through with the built-in spoolie.

tabs.Характеристики: A tinting brow product in a compact mascara format. It coats hairs with color and sets them in shape; soften the shade by brushing your brows after application. The line has several tones, including browns and cooler shades.
tabs.Применение: Wipe off excess product on the neck of the tube and brush the mini spoolie through the hairs, setting them in the direction you want. Start with a small amount; add a second layer once the first has dried if needed.

tabs.Характеристики: A soft automatic pencil with a gel texture for lining, tightlining and soft smudging. Some versions can be used to accent the lower lash line.
tabs.Применение: Twist out only a small amount of the tip to avoid breakage. Draw a thin line at the base of your lashes; smudge quickly after applying if you want a soft effect. Close the cap tightly.
Glide the stick lightly over your lid or transfer a little product with your finger. Blend the edge before it sets, if needed.
Apply in short strokes along the upper lash line. For a softer result, smudge the line slightly right after applying.

tabs.Состав: Ingredients depend on the product and shade. Use a suitable eye makeup remover to take off long-wear makeup.
tabs.Применение: Draw along your lash line with thin strokes. Don’t apply to the waterline; close the cap after use.

tabs.Характеристики: Liquid shimmer shadow with particles of different sizes. Use it as an accent on the lid or to highlight the brow bone and inner corner.
tabs.Состав: The key effect comes from light-reflecting glitter particles. Avoid getting particles directly in your eyes.
tabs.Применение: Apply a small amount to the chosen area of your lid with the applicator or your finger. Let it dry before layering or applying other products nearby. Don’t apply to the waterline, and stop using it if irritation occurs.

tabs.Характеристики: A slim automatic pencil for a precise line along the lashes. The 0.14 g size is great for neat eye makeup detailing.
tabs.Состав: The Black shade lists iron oxide pigments and carbon black, the film former trimethylsiloxysilicate, volatile silicones and waxes.
tabs.Применение: Draw a thin line along your upper or lower lash line. Don’t twist out too much of the tip or press hard on it. Close the cap after use; stop if you feel discomfort.
Draw the tip along your upper lash line from the inner corner outward. For a thin line, keep the tip close to the lashes; for a wing, gradually widen it. Close after use.
Apply along the lash line in small strokes. For a soft outline, smudge the line right after applying.

tabs.Характеристики: A liquid pen eyeliner for fine lines and wings. Available in different shades.

tabs.Характеристики: A flexible mask for at-home light treatments. CurrentBody’s current page describes Series 2 with 633 nm red light, 830 nm near-infrared and 1072 nm deep near-infrared; it has 236 diodes, and a session takes about 10 minutes.
tabs.Состав: This is an electronic device, not a cosmetic. Its key specs are three wavelengths, 236 LEDs and a stated power density of 30 mW/cm² for Series 2. The previous Series 1 has a different number of diodes and set of wavelengths.
tabs.Применение: The current page gives a gradual schedule of 3–5 treatments a week for eight weeks. Before first use, do a sensitivity test as instructed; if you feel heat, itching or discomfort, stop the session. Follow the contraindications section of the manual.

tabs.Состав: According to the brand, the diodes sit close to the skin to light the face evenly.
tabs.Применение: Cleanse and dry your skin, put on the mask and choose a mode according to the instructions for your model. tabs.Применение: Apply serum or gel to cleansed skin. Turn on the device and slowly glide the head over your face from bottom to top, 1–2 minutes per zone. Use 3–5 times a week. Charge as instructed.

tabs.Характеристики: A device for deep hydration and glow: it helps serums and gels penetrate deeper, so skin looks nourished and fresh. Compact, with a handy head for working by zones.

tabs.Применение: Apply gel or serum to cleansed skin. Choose a mode and slowly glide the head over your face from bottom to top without lingering in one spot. A treatment takes about 10 minutes, 2–3 times a week. Don’t use on irritated skin or near the eyes.

medicube-age-r-booster-v-roller.description: Set: EMS V-roller for a defined jawline and mini booster

tabs.Характеристики: A set of two devices. The V-roller with two metal balls and EMS pulses massages and tones facial muscles — your face looks more defined and your chin more lifted. The illuminated mini booster helps serums and gels absorb better and gives skin a glow.
tabs.Применение: Apply gel to cleansed skin. Roll the V-roller from your chin toward your ears and up along your cheekbones for 5–10 minutes. Then go over areas that need glow with the mini booster. Use 3–5 times a week.

makeon-skin-light-therapy-3s.description: Light therapy and EMS device with a 3-second skin analysis

tabs.Применение: Apply serum to cleansed skin. Turn on the device and let it analyze your skin, or choose a mode yourself (Boosting, Toning, Relaxing, Contouring). Glide over your face from bottom to top, 1–2 minutes per zone. 3–5 times a week.

lg-pral-total-lift-up-care.description: RF, microcurrent and LED for lifting

medicube-age-r-derma-tox.description: EMS roller massager for firm skin
